column1: # CLASS: RAW_MEASUREMENT — normalized measurement events.  Only the graphs of the exact governed series
# are retained: one comparison-baseline (entry-cold-1) and the current cold set; git history owns every
# superseded graph.  Every basis is registered in performance-bases.tsv and verified against its exact
# source commit; the required-event grammar of the registered topology is enforced (a required event
# cannot be omitted, renamed, re-parented, or given different edges); each row states its timing clock and
# native resolution (HOST_SECONDS/PROC_UPTIME_10MS/BUILDKIT_LOG_OFFSET/DERIVED) and a row cannot claim
# finer precision than its source; the governing totals are computed ONLY by tools/perf-work-span.py.
# entry-cold-1: the 148s three-solve run at the c13e3d5 candidate (comparison-baseline; whole-second host
# timing, the verbose Buildx log was not retained; the scenario median across runs was 151s, range
# 148-159, so entry comparisons are conservative lower bounds).
